summary: The retained production thigh previously stopped at 0.58 of the solved hip-to-knee segment, leaving a visible diagonal break before the assembled knee and allowing the knee volume to dominate the profile. Continuous Thigh/Knee V1 extends the closed tapered wetsuit thigh through the solved knee, gives the thigh a larger proximal volume, and narrows the mesh toward the knee. Guide, broadest, and smallest-body front/profile/rear captures now show a continuous thigh-to-knee silhouette with the knee transition narrower than the thigh.

root_cause.disconnected_joint: The opaque profile-hip bridge ended at 0.58 of the solved hip-to-knee segment, leaving the distal thigh uncovered before the assembled knee.
root_cause.oversized_knee_relationship: The short retained thigh was only 6.8 cm at maximum radius, so the assembled knee read as a separate larger mass instead of a continuation of the upper leg.
root_cause.retained_shape: The existing 377-vertex closed tapered tube is extended from -0.15 to 1.06 of the solved hip-to-knee segment. Its 8.0 cm maximum radius fills the upper leg while the analytic end profile narrows toward the knee, and both caps remain buried inside overlapping pelvis or assembled-leg geometry.

renderer_evidence.photoreal_verdict: fail pending named review or replacement of the still-simplified procedural thigh anatomy, deformation, seams and wet material response
